$comment: C48 Data Domain Level (data taxonomy, D-37; docs/architecture/data-taxonomy.md). Balanced has three levels.
A top-level domain has no parent to inherit an owner from, so the top level requires its own owner. Lower levels inherit the owner of the nearest domain above them (OP-15).
Balanced holds no domains: the tree is the client's own. The overlay data-domains-starter holds a generic tree to rename.

rows.label: Domain
rows.description: A business area, such as Customers or People.

rows.label: Subdomain
rows.description: A body of data inside a business area, such as Payroll under People.

rows.label: Data set
rows.description: A narrower set inside a subdomain, such as Bank details under Payroll.
